title: PES 0110 writes the Appliqué wizard's output as PE-DESIGN's appliqué lines and colours
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes the Appliqué wizard's stages as CEmbLine objects with PE-DESIGN's appliqué colours (catalogue numbers 100 Applique Material, 101 Applique Position, 102 Applique; colour type 2) and line types (running material and position lines, a V tack-down with its width in the E/V field, the covering zigzag), as PE-DESIGN 11.50's Applique Wizard writes them for a 20 mm square (the owner's a01-rect-applique, crates/openstitch-formats/tests/fixtures/pe11/PROVENANCE.md, round 4 Applique Wizard). The square is (10,10)-(30,30) mm in 007 PRUSSIAN BLUE; the wizard runs at PE-DESIGN's dialog defaults (material running, tack-down V 2.0 mm, cover zigzag 3.0 mm at 4.5 line/mm, Add at 3.0 mm).

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, PES 0110 object list, Applique Wizard: mapped from the owner's a01-a05; the writer's rewrite of those files is byte-identical outside the documented differences (pes11.rs, written_object_sections_match_pe_designs_bytes_outside_the_documented_differences)

PE-DESIGN 11.50 re-save of a.pes (MANIFEST pes-0110-applique, 2026-10-31): opens with no warning, the lines editable in PE-DESIGN's appliqué colours; the object section unchanged but for PE-DESIGN's own pattern blocks. The export of 2026-10-30 was refused for its partial group

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-applique` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-applique/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open). Expected: the 20 mm square and the appliqué lines around it as editable shapes, as the owner's a01-rect-applique.pes: Sewing Order shows the square, then the material line in APPLIQUE MATERIAL, the position line in APPLIQUE POSITION, the V tack-down in APPLIQUE, then the covering zigzag. Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether the file opens and with what warning, the colours each line shows in Sewing Order (APPLIQUE MATERIAL / POSITION / APPLIQUE expected), whether each line's attributes can be changed, and the status-bar size and stitch count against a01's (32,60 x 32,80 mm, 1063 stitches). Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11's Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 file signature

the square and the four appliqué lines as five CEmbLine objects; OpenStitch's wizard groups the four lines without the square, a partial group PE-DESIGN refuses (2026-10-31), so the export writes no group (a01-rect-applique groups all five)
